query_rewrites: non-Windows file searches with an extension or filename pattern map to the corpus wording Find files by extension
Windows move requests that imply distinct drives map to the corpus wording Move a file or directory across drives
ranking: raw cosine distance minus 0.05 per shared query/candidate token plus 0.05 times the fraction of detected action/constraint rules without example-specific evidence
example_selection: retain same-page candidates in the top-k; display the top three after reranking
fusion: dense candidate pool reranked by 0.05 per shared lexical token and bounded operational fit penalty
abstention: raw distance cutoff 0.60 plus scoped negation and unsupported-intent guards; operational fit changes ranking only
